name: Dancing with Shadows
source: Dahlia, a witch with unmatched cunning, hunts the arcane and bends mortals to her will. Only the brave – or the clever – can navigate her schemes, uncover ancient secrets, and survive the crypt’s deadly embrace.
translation: 达莉亚是一位狡猾无比的女巫，她追寻奥术并让凡人屈服于她的意志。只有勇敢的人——或者聪明的人——才能驾驭她的计划，揭开古老的秘密，并在地穴的致命拥抱中幸存下来。
